title: Sine And Cosine
description: Interactive simulation for Sine And Cosine
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Sine
learningObjectives: Identify sine as the vertical coordinate and cosine as the horizontal coordinate of a point on the unit circle
Explain how one full 0-360 degree trip around the circle traces exactly one period of the sine and cosine graphs
Predict the sign of sine and cosine in each of the four quadrants as the animated point sweeps around
Compare the sine and cosine curves and identify the 90-degree phase shift between them
Identify the angles where sine reaches its maximum of 1 and where cosine crosses zero
